name: absolute-paths-at-tool-boundary
body:
The curated suite tools hand consumers absolute filesystem paths while the durable graph stores checkout-independent repo-relative identities. Each curated tool resolves a stored identity against the project directory it is given before returning it, so apg_file_path, apg_file_units, apg_hunk, … yield paths a consumer opens directly. Raw apg query is the graph view and returns the stored repo-relative form; re-basing happens at the curated-tool boundary alone, external to the artifact.

The suite's shared plumbing discovers the project root (ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.findApgRoot) and runs the fixed Cypher templates (ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.runCypher) from that root; with the graph's File fqn repo-relative, the tools join it back to the caller's project directory.

Acceptance criteria:
- A curated tool given a stored repo-relative File fqn returns an absolute path under the caller's project directory.
- The same stored identity resolves to different absolute paths in two checkouts at the same commit.
- Raw apg query returns the stored repo-relative form unchanged.
- The re-basing follows the tool's directory argument rather than cwd alone.
